It depends on R0.02 and R0.05.

researchRegisterB02.summary: The planning row requires Ajv 8.17.1 and the latest stable Zod 4.x, with exact selection evidence recorded in B02 and a sole pin in packages/contracts/package.json. The register prose remains generic, but specs/gates/B02-R0-selection.json records the exact zod@4.6.5 selection, owner, registry artifact integrity and shasum, selectionVerdict PASS, lockMatchesRegistry, and original plus current implementation dependency digests. That selection record does not establish runtime compatibility or complete R0.10/R1 acceptance.

obligations.summary: Section 3 marks Node/PostgreSQL/pg-boss/pg/Ajv and recurrence pins as proposed, not installed or compatibility-tested; Ops owns the one shared runtime/queue lock and migration. Section 20 step 2 is the exact pg-boss transaction/worker/claim-loss/recurrence spike and requires disposable PostgreSQL fault-test evidence. BUILD-PLAN cites this as Obligations §20.2; the target content is the second row of §20's step table, not a separately headed subsection.

contracts.summary: CONTRACTS is authoritative for canonical names/owners. It pins Node 24.21.0, PostgreSQL 17.11, pg-boss 12.36.0/schema 44, and pg 8.23.1; the M04 amendment puts the single Zod pin in @toy/contracts and forbids module-local Zod pins.

assignedAcceptanceTests.scope: The pre-build register blocks on missing primary evidence, unsupported choices, or missing acceptance links; the full option comparison and validation plan are required.
Research receipts prove Sol/medium/Fast and resolved research-skill version/hash while ordinary delegation keeps its distinct route.
Application and native pg-boss transactions exercise rollback and lost-claim fencing through executeSql; five schemas validate with declared dialects and there is one queue-schema owner.
Principal and large-bigint values round-trip exactly through tool/client/Python/Swift DTOs with canonical decimal strings and immutable UTF-8 observation text.
Generated cadence contracts keep the single Durable admission/Turn Review owner and canonical states; duplicate writers and noncanonical enums fail.
Generated profile keys are consumed by intended subsystems; unsupported or ignored keys fail validation.
Life Store HTTP and the pinned MCP loader connect using supported transport without an unsupported override.
The research gate requires compared proven options, primary evidence, reliability decisions, validation IDs, and the prescribed research-route receipt.
Registry and protected-release validation enforce shared pins, pg-boss schema 44, one toolset, typed adapters, and maintained crypto/authentication.
Generated cadence contracts leave cadence_slot/run/review writes with Durable admission/Turn Review and distinguish swept from accepted AI-reviewed coverage.
